271240390_a9790f35.text: The amygdaloid complex includes over a dozen nuclei and can be segregated into five groups (Beyeler and Dabrowska, 2020): (1) the BLA divided into a dorsal section (lateral amygdala, LA) and basal section (basal amygdala, BA), (2) the basomedial amygdala (BMA), (3) the central amygdala (CeA) further splits into medial, lateral, and central sections (CeM, CeL, and CeC), (4) the medial amygdala (MeA), and (5) the cortical amygdala (CoA)
